notes.title: Ranking System - Yet another Racket Fury update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28128134/90425f322f6068d56570bbe510f7701751448b8c.png

I am excited to let you know that Racket Fury’s got yet another update!

The community here is so supportive and motivating that I couldn’t resist working on the feature lots of you brought up. So off you go! Enjoy the ranking system that works separately for arcade and sim mode :-)

Here’s a complete list of improvements/fixes this update provides:

 Ranking system!
 Separate ranking for arcade & simulation
 Friend List ranking info
 Four Profile buttons in Main Menu
 Improved paddle velocity calculation
 Added Supersampling 1.3 & 1.4 options
 Improved net physics
 Different colors for simulation and arcade
 Minor fixes as usual ;-)


Please, feel free to share your insights and suggestions! I truly believe that the ranking system will make the game much more competitive and it will encourage you to perform the best you can :-)

notes.title: Racket Fury 3.2 Major Physics Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I have prepared a crucial update for you that focuses on paddle-ball bounce kinematics and ball smoothness improvement.

As I could see some players were complaining about the simulation part of the game. 

I have rewritten the whole paddle-bounce kinematics which provides the whole new experience, especially in the Simulation Mode. 

Before it was hard to exchange even a few rallies in the online simulation match, and that was the main reason why I spent so much time improving it and making the experience as close to real-life as possible. 

The difference is so big that I decided to set the "Simulation Mode" as default in the game. Of course, you will see a huge improvement in the Arcade Mode as well :-)

I hope you will like it!

notes.title: Major update - Arcade mode, new scenery, Chinese localization and practice mode!
notes.content:
We’d like to announce Racket Fury keeps changing for the better and is getting closer to Full Release! With this major update, we’re bringing several changes and improvements into the game.  

 1) Two modes to choose from - Full Simulation and Arcade mode 
So far, Racket Fury has been all about real-life table tennis experience. We’ve put lots of effort into developing the most accurate in-game physics as possible, by tweaking it with professional table tennis players. 

Anyway, there’s also a certain group of players who are looking for pure fun while playing table tennis. Hence our decision to let the players choose between two variants of the game - Full Simulation or Arcade Mode that provides gameplay assist. In arcade mode, your reflexes and tactics are top priorities and they’re of much greater importance than your skills. 

Adding the Arcade mode extends the scope of in-game content, as there are now two campaigns to go through! 

https://youtu.be/xW_gY4nVDeU

 2) Additional scenery - Dusty Outskirts 

Eager to play on a different arena? We’ve added additional scenery so now you can defeat your opponents in two different environments. 

https://youtu.be/MAagg83jfpI

 3) Practice mode PRO 
This feature enables you to enhance your skills and become stronger with every match because from now on you can practice like a pro. 

https://youtu.be/_UxKoQYdi7w

 4) Improved game dynamics  
To make the game much more dynamic, we removed the gaps between the point and your serve. Now you can start an exchange without further ado ;-)

 5) Chinese localization 

We're curious what you think about the new features so don't forget to post your feedback here! :-)

notes.title: Racket Fury - EA Update #1 : Multiplayer Physics Fix & Improved AI behavior
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We'd like to share some improvements with you (those we are capable of publishing right now).

#1 Fixed multiplayer physics issue - now you shouldn't experience any problems with physics in multiplayer mode. 

#2 Improved AI behavior in single player mode - taking into account GD73FIVR's feedback, we managed to make some corrections in AI behavior. Right now, every shot the AI makes has some spin (like in real life). Naturally, the higher the cup, the more advanced and stronger shots the AI is capable of. What we learned is that on the higher levels (Gold Clash+)  every shot AI makes should with any doubts be on the pro level (no more weak shoots at this level!). 

More updates are coming so you can expect several things to be changed/improved/fixed/added such as:

- replay mode,
- advanced practice mode,
- multiplayer 'friends' feature,
- many, many more ;-)

Perhaps the changes are in limited amounts but they are quite crucial. Let us know how you like this update!

notes.title: Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR Early Access Trailer & Beta Update #5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, we hereby proudly present our newest Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR Early Access Trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tB1YXqHM5nE

The project is in its 10 month of development and now we are ready to hit Early Access on Steam, after we wrap up our closed beta phase [don’t worry more beta updates are coming]. We would like to thank our beta testers for their tremendous feedback and for their dedication to help us bring Racket Fury to a much higher level of quality and performance.

Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR will go live on 27.07.2017.


Of course we're still working very very hard vefore the launch and we have some improvements and bug fixes in beta #5

Bug Fixes
We've reweritten AI shoot animation code. There should be no problem anymore with AI returning the shoots in the air. Also the animations should be much smoother now. fixed


Improvements


Now there is a difference in reward (gold, exp will come in next update) between character for example from the first and the last cup.
Racket Fury Workshop item pricing rewritten.
Improved game summary window
Some changes in AI difficulty level, there will be more changes in next update

notes.title: Racket Fury - Beta Update #2 & Launch Date Postponed to 27.07.2017
notes.content:
Dear Racket Fury fans,

We would like to thank our tremendous beta testers for their immense dedication and the amount of detail that enabled us to really fix up a lot of issues prior to our release. So, with this announcement we are forced to move our release date to 27.07.2017. Racket Fury will go live into the Early Access phase and we can promise that this date will be final. 

We have been working hard to fix most of the known issues and we are satisfied with the amount we have been able to cover. Thanks of course to our wonderful and dedicated beta testers. Here's the anticipated list:

Settings Added
Turn on / off ball trajectory effect - fixed
Turn on / off ball impact area - fixed
Turn on / off ball spin effect - fixed
Turn on / off ball smash effect - fixed
Adjust the paddle's angle - fixed
Select your grip on the paddle (hand model will automatically adjust) - fixed
Select the playing hand - now you are able to select the playing hand and we are truly sorry for all the lefties that were unable to play our game. Now you should be able to smash your way through the beta test!
Adjust haptic feedback - adjusted

Video Settings
Set supersampling level - added
Possibility to preview FPS - added

Paddle Settings
Set Paddle Spin Settings - added
Set Paddle Speed Settings -  added


Improvements

Physics

Big improvement in paddle versatility measurement - now you shouldn't feel that you are limited with how strong you can hit [Also we have added paddle speed settings in options]
Improved ball behaviour when it’s spinning in the air
Improved ball impact when it hits the table
The ball shouldn't go through the paddle now


General
Saving without Cloud - there shouldn't be a problem with saving now
Added post-match summary
Fixed Single Player Campaign progress bug

User Experience
Improved window transition during gameplay and animation
Now you can disable the robot's grip in the paddle settings

Graphics
Same map in map selection "soon" - fixed
Bad score adjustment on the table - fixed

User Interface
Add a "Start" button before the match, which will allow both players to warm up - added
Making the table reposition that will also affect the menu. Add table repository options from the main menu - added

Previous bug fixes can be found here.

We're working extra hard to improve those pesky bugs and we are confident that with moving the release date we will be able to deliver a tremendous experience for newcomers and veterans alike. We are truly sorry that you have to wait for one additional week, but we want to fix as many bugs as we possibly can.

We hope to see our beta testers and new players battling it out when Racket Fury hits Early Access on 27.07.2017!

notes.title: Racket Fury - Beta Update #1
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

First of all, we would like to thank you for the tremendous amount of feedback we have gathered from the beta phase. Your help has been invaluable! 
Also, we would like to apologize for the delay. It took us a bit more work to fix those issues, but we have definitely made a huge leap in the quality of the game. Once again, thank you from the entire 10Ants Hill.

Before you dive into what we have prepared for you, we have decided to extend the beta phase up until 21.07.2017. This should give you and ourselves a lot of time to polish Racket Fury before its final release.

NEWLY ADDED FEATURES
Unfortunately, some of these options had to be deactivated but we’re going activate them again right after the weekend. Also, the ball effects are off (default setting).

Added Options in the Menu - you will find the available options below:

Game Settings
Turn on / off ball trajectory effect
Turn on / off ball impact area
Turn on / off ball spin effect
Turn on / off ball smash effect
Adjust the paddle's angle
Set the distance between the paddle and the controller
Select your grip on the paddle (hand model will automatically adjust)
Select the ball's design and color
Select the playing hand 
Adjust haptic feedback

Video Settings
Set supersampling level
Possibility to preview FPS

Sound Settings
Set the HUD volume
Set the audience's volume

Paddle Settings
Paddle Spin Strength
Grip Settings
Paddle Orientation
Paddle Position [On Monday]

Miscellaneous
Added table reposition option from the controller
Thanks to this you can adjust the position, height and angle of the table and at the same time your playing space.

BUG FIXES
We've fixed a lot of them thanks to your feedback!

Physics
Paddle physics
Significantly improved. You shouldn’t have any problems with the spins any more. 
Pay attention to “Paddle Spin” option in the Settings to adjust spin parameters according to your preferences. 
We realize the ball still goes through the paddle from time to time but we’ll work on that.

Game Logic
Added net logic when serving
Fixed lost point logic when volleying
Fixed the ability to play around with the ball before serving

User Interface
Improved button visibility on the controller during gameplay
Added button descriptions on the controller in the main menu

Practice
Changed the opponent; now it should be much easier to train
Deleted startup error when clicking on restart after a match


Once again, we would like to thank our beta testers for putting in the time in helping us develop Racket Fury.

notes.title: Racket Fury Closed Beta Status Update #1
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28128134/c8d2c4ae15253145ae6edd1f4af5d92767e65c3d.jpg

Hello everyone,

First of all, welcome to our very first Racket Fury announcement! We would like to thank everyone for taking their time in completing the Racket Fury Closed Beta survey and we are really looking forward to your feedback.

Of course, you can still become a beta tester by applying here!

Unfortunately, we have to postpone the launch of our Closed Beta as well as the full release to May 2017. The reason is fairly simple; we simply want to put the finishing touches and ensure our beta testers will have fun during this phase. The provided feedback will be invaluable. We hope everyone will understand and we promise to deliver a great VR game!

Stay tuned for more information!

Also, be sure to join our still growing Steam community - at least say hello! :-)

Together we can do it and we simply can't wait to see what the future will bring. Thank you for all your support!
